'''Item stands''' are decorative structures that can be used to display trophies or other resources a player may have collected. They come in two variants, vertical and horizontal. == Usage == Items that can be put on an item stand: * All [[Food]] except [[Honey]] (horizontal only) * All [[Bombs]] (also [[Basalt Bomb]]) * [[Ancient Seed]] * [[Asksvin egg]] * [[Barber Kit]] * [[Barrel Hoops]] * [[Bell]] * [[Black Core]] * [[Celestial Feather]] * [[Dandelion]] * [[Dragon Egg]] * [[Dragon Tear]] * [[Dverger Circlet]] * [[Dvergr Tankard]] * [[Egg]] * [[Fish]] * [[Fuling Totem]] * [[Hildir#Trading|Hildir's]] hats * [[Hildir#Trading|Hildir's]] chests (horizontal only) * Meads (horizontal only) * [[Midsummer Crown]] * [[Molten Core]] * [[Proustite Powder]] * Saddles * [[Scythe]] * [[Scythe Handle]] * [[Sealbreaker]] * [[Shields]] * [[Surtling Core]] * [[Swamp Key]] * [[Thistle]] * [[:Category:Tools|Tools]] * [[Torn Spirit]] * [[Trinkets]] * [[Trophies]] * [[Volture Egg]] * [[Weapons]] excluding Arrows and Bolts * [[Yule Hat]] Items that cannot be put on an item stand: * [[:Category:Accessories|Accessories]] * [[Armor]] (excluding the ones above) * [[Arrows]] * [[Asksvin Skeleton|Askvin Skeleton]] components * [[Bell Fragment]] * [[Black Marble]] * [[:Category:Bolts|Bolts]] * [[Charcoal Resin]] * [[Crystal]] * [[Dvergr Extractor]] * [[Fader Relic]] * [[Feathers]] * Gems * [[Grausten]] * [[Guck]] * Hide * [[Honey]] * [[Majestic Carapace]] * Mead bases * Metals * Nails * [[Needle]] * Ores * Pelts * [[Pot Shard]] * Raw meats * [[Resin]] * [[:Category:Seeds|Seeds]] (excluding [[Jotun Puffs]] and [[Magecap]]) * [[Soft Tissue]] * [[Stone]] * [[Sulfur]] * [[Tar]] * [[Thunder Stone]] * [[Torch]] * [[:Category:Valuables|Valuables]] * [[Withered Bone]] * Wood ''(This list is incomplete and will be updated as we go)'' == Notes == * Rotating the vertical item stand will flip horizontally but not vertically; so "crossed swords" are not possible at this time. == Gallery == Item stands.png|Item stands holding trophies and a [[Dragon Egg]]. '''Tables''' are furniture. They can be used for placing items on top or as simple decorative objects.

== Common properties ==
Tables provide [[comfort]], but they do not stack with each other: only the highest-comfort table in a player's vicinity will provide comfort.

All tables have the following damage resistances:
* '''Weak''': [[Chop]]
* '''Neutral''': [[Blunt]], [[Slash]], [[Pickaxe]], [[Fire]], [[Frost]], [[Lightning]]
* '''Resistant''': [[Pierce]]
* '''Immune''': [[Poison]], [[Spirit]]

'''Snowball''' is a [[Deep North]] weapon.

==Usage==
* It can be thrown for 5 [[Blunt]] and 10 [[Frost]] damage, at a cost of 8 [[Stamina]].
* Required to build the {{item link|Snow Lantern}}, which uses 8 Snowballs.
* Each thrown snowball has a 3.5% chance to create a rolling snowball where it hits. In deep snow in the [[Deep North]], a rolling snowball grows as it rolls and cleans snow in its path. It has 150 health, is weak to [[Fire]], and is immune to [[Frost]], [[Lightning]], [[Poison]] and [[Spirit]] damage.

==Availability==
* 10 '''Snowballs''' can be crafted by hand from 5 {{Item link|Ice}}.
* Always dropped by [[Greydwarf (Deep North)]].
* Found on the ground all around [[Deep North]].

Snowballs stack up to 50.
